2608.06305.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
2608.06305.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding space, and a figure inherits its unit from a header a median of 13 lines above it -- so a chunk boundary routinely separates a number from whether it is in lakh or crore, an error of two orders of magnitude. A table-aware chunker built as a steelman fixes the unit problem but leaves 27-30% of numeric chunks with no fiscal-year header at every chunk size we tried. We propose READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), in which an agent reads the raw document through three deterministic operations -- normalized lexical search, structural navigation, and bounded span reads -- exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so a trajectory is a replayable audit trail, not an opaque similarity score. On 51 verified questions READ answers 58.8% against dense retrieval's 15.7% (p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5) -- or 35.3% tuned, which READ still leads by 23.5 points (p_Holm = 0.017). An agent given the same loop but a top-k tool reaches only 27.5%, locating the gain in the interface rather than in iteration. We also report what the evidence does not support: BM25 is statistically indistinguishable from READ, so our result separates embedding-based from embedding-free retrieval, not agentic from lexical search.
2608.06305.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成在長文件上的應用主要由一種設計主導：將文本分塊，嵌入這些塊，並顯示查詢的前k個最近鄰。我們認為，對於一類重要的文件——財務報表、審計報告、監管回報——這種設計在結構上是不合理的，我們使這一論點可度量。在一份780頁的政府財務報告中，86.8%的內容行是表格行，數千個幾乎相同的數字在一個嵌入空間中競爭，而一個數字的單位從其上方中位數為13行的標題繼承——因此，塊邊界常常將一個數字與它是以 lakh 還是 crore 為單位分開，這是一個兩個數量級的錯誤。一個以鋼人論證構建的表格感知分塊器解決了單位問題，但在我們嘗試的每個塊大小中，仍有27-30%的數字塊沒有財政年度標題。我們提出了READ（可靠的無嵌入代理文檔搜索），其中一個代理通過三個確定性操作——標準化詞彙搜索、結構導航和有界範圍讀取——來讀取原始文檔，這些操作在模型上下文協議中暴露，因此一個軌跡是一個可重播的審計痕跡，而不是不透明的相似度分數。在51個經過驗證的問題中，READ的回答率為58.8%，而密集檢索為15.7%（p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5）——或調整後的35.3%，READ仍然領先23.5個點（p_Holm = 0.017）。一個給定相同循環但使用top-k工具的代理僅達到27.5%，其增益出現在界面而不是迭代中。我們還報告了證據不支持的內容：BM25在統計上與READ無法區分，因此我們的結果將基於嵌入的檢索與無嵌入的檢索分開，而不是代理與詞彙搜索。
